brief: Prioritise Rushmere Junction 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-732) for pre-event attention, where clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity if a vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding [SOP-011]. Complete work on failed or degraded forced cooling, obstructed ventilation or airflow, and oil level below minimum or active leaks before the event begins wherever crew capacity allows [SOP-016]. Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event [MG-023].
